data_rules: Equipment is an item-facing entity layer; item records remain the source of truth for stats and exact item properties.
Do not invent Forever stat lines, item levels, class restrictions, or weapon/armor details.
Use stable IDs so equipment can later connect to item pages, profession recipes, dungeon loot, guides, and market records.
When a Forever item has multiple versions, represent the shared equipment identity separately from individual item records.
